base_member_text: [L17-L22] (LOW/api/scalar-coverage) No cases are emitted for scalar variables, leaving scalar-index behavior to unspecified surrounding control flow.

base_member_text: [L17-L21] (MED/allocation/precondition) Generated cases allocate the target pointer without checking whether it is already associated or exposing a failure status, so the caller must satisfy an unstated one-shot precondition.
audit_member_text: [L17-L21] (MED/allocation/lifecycle) Indexed allocation is unconditional and has no ASSOCIATED guard or STAT handling, so allocating an already associated component can fail at runtime without a recoverable status.
